# `snaidhm`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_api_docs.py from snaidhm/src/mod.almd; do not edit. -->

_The renderer: colours, frames, shapes, images._

snaidhm — the renderer every ceangal2 pixel goes through.

Immediate-mode per frame: begin(), then fill/stroke/shadow/glyph/image
calls append 80-byte instances (shader.almd), then end() uploads them once
and draws them in a single pass, split only where the bound image texture
changes. Coordinates are physical pixels, top-left origin.

```almide
import snaidhm
```

## Submit

### `end`

```almide
pub fn end(clear: Color) -> Bool
```

Draw everything recorded since begin() onto this frame's target, cleared
to `clear`. Returns false when the host had no target (minimised window).
